verdict.rationale: The pack contains no first-party Gemini API documentation of spending caps, budgets, or usage alerts. The only first-party items are rate-limit visibility in AI Studio and a mention of prepaid and pay-as-you-go pricing, which are adjacent controls rather than spend caps. Community reports describe Google Cloud billing budget alerts, a host-platform feature that fired hours late (comm-7), and say no easy hard cap exists for the Gemini API (comm-8), so nothing credits a product-native spending cap.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set spending caps, budgets, or usage alerts so a runaway workload cannot generate an unbounded bill
